d: Two Ferrari F1 drivers, one garage and two very different ambitions. Lewis Hamilton has refused to apologise for speaking openly about his frustration with Charles Leclerc, reigniting the debate around Ferrari's team dynamics. From the controversial Mexico GP clash to the history of teammate rivalries involving Hamilton, Nico Rosberg, Sebastian Vettel and Mark Webber, Rupha Ramani looks at why Formula 1's Drivers' Championship and Constructors' Championship often put teammates on opposing sides.
